notes_for_editor: Low confidence; thin record. The Register entry is the only substantive source; the Forest Lookouts page has a heading and county only. Two searches found no Marion County, KY fire tower named Gilboa; the results were about other towers and were not linked. Status 'standing' is inferred from the present-tense Register description (partly missing cab) and is recorded as a status note. 'Unknown' agency is the Register's own wording. No photo URL captured. Access, staffing, design and events are absent from every source read. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story no longer calls the tower also known as Mt. Gilboa, because the Forest Lookouts page does not say it is the same tower; the January 8, 2021 date is the Register registration date, not a nomination date. The JSON facts are unchanged.
